priorityAndCollision.input: valid context follow-up > recognized motion special/Drive > normal throw chord > direction normal > proximity/remaining normal; a legal fresh/buffered jump request precedes grounded FD. Reject unavailable recognized cashout without fallback.
priorityAndCollision.cancelAllowlist: named lists have precedence over schema22 broad button masks, including its universal same-button command exception
priorityAndCollision.simultaneous: Classify every eligible melee AND projectile contact first. A connecting qualifying strike defeats a same-tick capture before pair immunity; no command resource consumption. Any two otherwise-legal ground captures clash without damage/status consumption. Resolve attack trades from pre-application state.
priorityAndCollision.stageEdges: for paired release, choose desired order and separation, translate the pair together inside both wall bounds, then resolve; do not silently shrink separation
priorityAndCollision.facing: action entry locks facing; 236K has exactly one declared late update; capture release restores opponent-facing
priorityAndCollision.pairClock: C0 confirmed capture; declared capture hitstop first; C1..CN paired action ticks, then release hitstop, then independent post-release recovery; all shared freezes stop both pair clocks
priorityAndCollision.pairSafety: confirmed pair removes both from independent strike/throw targeting until release recovery starts; pre-capture same-tick strikes still win; no repeated move active frames after success
priorityAndCollision.jump: Fresh or buffered valid Up accepted before grounded FD when legally actionable. Preserve the five-world-tick buffer and no held-Up autojump. Each command attempt latches existing/new airborne/prejump from acceptance through23.
priorityAndCollision.airCancel: landing on the frame an air normal would contact cancels it according to landing policy before contact; no extra last-frame grounded hit
priorityAndCollision.pairEntryCleanup: Consume pre-capture attack requests, clear old slow/combo/landing/reaction/motion state, preserve only explicitly sampled fresh tech input, and start a dedicated shared pair clock. Role recovery uses independent counters after release freeze.

productionRig.inbetween: Linear integer interpolation of wrist control keys per actor tick; solve elbow each tick; fixed heel/grip offsets; do not interpolate or stretch bone length.

attackTransitionContract.entry: No added ready-to-attack delay. Select first anticipation key on f1 from idle/walk/run/crouch; apply move advance/inertia before integration. Cancel begins new move f1 immediately.
attackTransitionContract.poseKeyPartition: Per-action exact keys in Fillet_V1 implementation_v0_2.json supersede a generic percentage partition. Hold resolved pose/geometry keys on actor action clocks.
attackTransitionContract.recovery: Author recovery pose keys instead of returning to ready while still recovering. Last recovery tick remains its last pose/boxes; idle begins only on next actionable tick, unless hit/block/landing/cancel supersedes it.
attackTransitionContract.inertiaApplication: At begin choose carry velocity only if its magnitude exceeds current vx, consume carry, then truncate toward zero(vx*move.inertiaPercent/100), clamp±4000. No second bleed multiplier. Translate x byvx, then authored startupTravel/activeTravel, then drag90 toward zero each actor tick.
